events.title: Operator requested a parallel governed review
events.summary: Run the Parallel lane repository review. Have Luna, Qwen, and GLM inspect the same frozen reservation-service repository in parallel. Independently verify each review against the same acceptance criteria. If any review passes, accept a verified result and do not invoke Sol. Only if all three reviews fail, create a sealed aggregate baton containing their findings and unresolved criteria and escalate it to Sol. Show every lane, route, decision, baton, verification result, and token total.

diagnostic.sanitisedInput: Same immutable repository bundle and acceptance criteria.
diagnostic.sanitisedOutput: All five source modules violate documented acceptance invariants; every acceptance test in test/acceptance.test.mjs corresponds to a proven defect in src/.

authorised.content: {"schema":"agent-control.repository-review/v1","executiveSummary":"All five source modules violate documented acceptance invariants; every acceptance test in test/acceptance.test.mjs corresponds to a proven defect in src/.","findings":[{"id":"F-001","severity":"high","title":"Reservation acquisition race violates single-owner invariant","category":"correctness","file":"src/reservation-ledger.mjs","startLine":6,"endLine":11,"evidence":"reserve() checks this.#owners.has(resourceId) then awaits audit() before setting the owner. Two concurrent callers both observe an empty map, both await, and both set the owner, returning true twice. This violates README.md invariant 1 ('At most one concurrent caller may acquire an unowned resource'). The acceptance test in test/acceptance.test.mjs lines 8-18 asserts only one outcome is truthy and would fail.","reasoning":"Check-then-act across an await point is a TOCTOU race; the ownership Map is mutated after an asynchronous suspension with no re-validation.","impact":"Two actors can both believe they hold an exclusive resource, breaking mutual exclusion guarantees.","suggestedRemediation":"Re-check ownership after the awaited audit completes, or set the owner synchronously before awaiting, or use an atomic compare-and-set pattern on the Map.","confidence":0.98,"validation":{"state":"VALID","reasons":[]}},{"id":"F-002","severity":"high","title":"hasRequiredScopes uses 'some' instead of 'every'","category":"correctness","file":"src/access-policy.mjs","startLine":2,"endLine":2,"evidence":"required.some(scope => granted.includes(scope)) returns true if ANY required scope is granted. README.md invariant 3 requires EVERY required scope to be granted. The acceptance test (test/acceptance.test.mjs lines 23-25) with granted=['read'], required=['read','admin'] asserts false, but the implementation returns true.","reasoning":"Direct semantic mismatch between some() and the documented 'every required scope is granted' invariant.","impact":"Authorization bypass: actors missing privileged scopes are granted access.","suggestedRemediation":"Replace .some with .every.","confidence":0.99,"validation":{"state":"VALID","reasons":[]}},{"id":"F-003","severity":"high","title":"page() treats limit as absolute end index","category":"correctness","file":"src/page-window.mjs","startLine":2,"endLine":2,"evidence":"records.slice(offset, limit) interprets limit as an end index. README.md invariant 4 requires 'at most limit records beginning at offset'. The acceptance test (test/acceptance.test.mjs lines 27-28) expects page(['a'..'e'], 2, 2) === ['c','d'], but slice(2, 2) yields [].","reasoning":"slice's second argument is the exclusive end index, not a count.","impact":"Empty or truncated pages for any offset > 0; data-access pagination is broken.","suggestedRemediation":"Use records.slice(offset, offset + limit).","confidence":0.99,"validation":{"state":"VALID","reasons":[]}},{"id":"F-004","severity":"high","title":"isFresh subtraction reversed, making every entry fresh","category":"correctness","file":"src/snapshot-cache.mjs","startLine":2,"endLine":2,"evidence":"entry.createdAt - now < ttlMs is negative for any now > createdAt, so the expression is true for arbitrarily old entries. README.md invariant 2 defines age as 'current time minus creation time'. The acceptance test (test/acceptance.test.mjs lines 20-22) with createdAt=1000, now=10000, ttl=1000 asserts false, but implementation returns true.","reasoning":"Operands of the age computation are swapped relative to the documented definition.","impact":"Stale snapshots are served indefinitely; no entry ever expires.","suggestedRemediation":"Use now - entry.createdAt < ttlMs.","confidence":0.99,"validation":{"state":"VALID","reasons":[]}},{"id":"F-005","severity":"high","title":"leaseIsValid mixes epoch seconds with epoch milliseconds","category":"correctness","file":"src/lease-validity.mjs","startLine":2,"endLine":2,"evidence":"issuedAtSeconds + maxAgeSeconds > nowMs adds a seconds-based quantity to a milliseconds-based clock. README.md invariant 5 requires leases valid until maxAgeSeconds later compared with an epoch-ms clock. The acceptance test (test/acceptance.test.mjs lines 30-32): 1_700_000_000 + 60 = 1_700_000_060 is not > 1_700_000_030_000, so it returns false where true is asserted.","reasoning":"Unit mismatch: seconds must be converted to milliseconds before comparison with nowMs.","impact":"All freshly issued leases are immediately reported invalid.","suggestedRemediation":"Convert issuedAtSeconds to ms, e.g. (lease.issuedAtSeconds * 1000) + (maxAgeSeconds * 1000) > nowMs.","confidence":0.98,"validation":{"state":"VALID","reasons":[]}},{"id":"F-006","severity":"medium","title":"Audit failure path leaves ledger in undefined intermediate state (maintainability concern)","category":"maintainability","file":"src/reservation-ledger.mjs","startLine":6,"endLine":11,"evidence":"reserve() performs await audit(...) before recording ownership. If audit throws, no ownership is recorded (correct), but combined with F-001 the ordering means neither the race nor the audit-failure path has a single clearly defined resolution ordering. Additionally, the default audit = async () => {} means silent success by default.","reasoning":"Maintainability/robustness concern rather than a directly testable invariant violation.","impact":"Ambiguous failure semantics for future evolution of the reserve path.","suggestedRemediation":"Define explicit ordering: record ownership atomically first (or re-validate after await), and document audit-failure semantics.","confidence":0.6,"validation":{"state":"VALID","reasons":[]}}],"positiveObservations":["Acceptance tests exercise each documented invariant and map cleanly to source modules.","README.md invariants are precise and unambiguous, making defects determinable from evidence alone."],"areasReviewed":["src/access-policy.mjs","src/lease-validity.mjs","src/page-window.mjs","src/reservation-ledger.mjs","src/snapshot-cache.mjs","test/acceptance.test.mjs","README.md"],"areasNotReviewed":[],"verdict":"PASS_WITH_FINDINGS"}

authorised.content: {"schema":"agent-control.repository-review/v1","executiveSummary":"The supplied acceptance fixture contains five supported correctness defects, one in each reviewed implementation area. These defects explain the expected acceptance failures; no execution evidence was supplied.","findings":[{"id":"F001","severity":"high","title":"Concurrent reservations can both succeed","category":"reliability","file":"src/reservation-ledger.mjs","startLine":5,"endLine":7,"evidence":"reserve checks ownership, awaits audit, and only then records the owner.","reasoning":"Two concurrent calls can both observe that the resource is unowned before either call reaches the assignment. Both then complete audit and set the owner, returning true. The ownership check and ownership update are not atomic across the await.","impact":"More than one concurrent caller can acquire the same unowned resource, violating acceptance invariant 1.","suggestedRemediation":"Serialize reservations per resource or record a pending ownership claim before awaiting audit, with explicit rollback/error handling if audit fails.","confidence":0.99,"validation":{"state":"VALID","reasons":[]}},{"id":"F002","severity":"high","title":"Old cache entries are incorrectly classified as fresh","category":"correctness","file":"src/snapshot-cache.mjs","startLine":2,"endLine":2,"evidence":"The freshness calculation is entry.createdAt - now < ttlMs.","reasoning":"For an entry created at 1,000 and checked at 10,000 with a 100 ms TTL, the expression evaluates to -9,000 < 100, which is true. The age must be calculated as now minus creation time; otherwise older entries produce increasingly negative values and remain fresh.","impact":"Expired snapshots can be served as fresh, violating acceptance invariant 2.","suggestedRemediation":"Compute now - entry.createdAt and require that age is below ttlMs.","confidence":1,"validation":{"state":"VALID","reasons":[]}},{"id":"F003","severity":"high","title":"Scope validation accepts partial scope matches","category":"security","file":"src/access-policy.mjs","startLine":3,"endLine":3,"evidence":"The function returns required.some(scope => granted.includes(scope)).","reasoning":"some succeeds when any one required scope is granted. A caller with only read therefore satisfies the required set [read, admin], although admin is missing.","impact":"Authorization checks can grant access when one or more mandatory scopes are absent, violating acceptance invariant 3 and potentially causing privilege escalation.","suggestedRemediation":"Require every required scope to be included in granted, using required.every(...).","confidence":1,"validation":{"state":"VALID","reasons":[]}},{"id":"F004","severity":"high","title":"Page limit is used as an absolute end index","category":"correctness","file":"src/page-window.mjs","startLine":2,"endLine":2,"evidence":"The function returns records.slice(offset, limit).","reasoning":"Array slice's second argument is an absolute end index, but the API contract defines limit as a count. With offset 2 and limit 2, the result is empty instead of records at indices 2 and 3.","impact":"Pages after the first can contain fewer than the requested records or be empty, violating acceptance invariant 4.","suggestedRemediation":"Use records.slice(offset, offset + limit), with any desired validation for offset and limit.","confidence":1,"validation":{"state":"VALID","reasons":[]}},{"id":"F005","severity":"high","title":"Lease validity compares seconds to milliseconds","category":"correctness","file":"src/lease-validity.mjs","startLine":2,"endLine":2,"evidence":"The function compares lease.issuedAtSeconds + maxAgeSeconds directly with nowMs.","reasoning":"issuedAtSeconds and maxAgeSeconds are expressed in seconds, while nowMs is expressed in milliseconds. Adding the seconds values yields a value around 1.7 billion, which is less than a current epoch-millisecond value around 1.7 trillion even when the lease is only 30 seconds old.","impact":"Recently issued leases are reported invalid, violating acceptance invariant 5.","suggestedRemediation":"Convert the issued timestamp and maximum age to milliseconds before comparing, or convert nowMs to epoch seconds consistently.","confidence":1,"validation":{"state":"VALID","reasons":[]}}],"positiveObservations":["The repository includes focused acceptance tests for all five documented invariants.","The lease comparison uses a strict greater-than boundary, which is consistent with freshness/validity being required only before expiry if that boundary is intended."],"areasReviewed":["Reservation concurrency and ownership recording","Snapshot cache freshness calculation","Required-scope authorization logic","Pagination window calculation","Lease validity unit conversion"],"areasNotReviewed":["Runtime behavior beyond the supplied source and acceptance evidence","Dependency and deployment configuration","External integrations and operational infrastructure"],"verdict":"PASS_WITH_FINDINGS"}

events.title: Qwen Review Lane: FAIL
events.summary: Independent gate rejected the result with 8 unresolved criterion/criteria.

diagnostic.sanitisedOutput:
Identify the reservation operation as a non-atomic check-then-update sequence, explicitly or by proving both callers check before either updates ownership.
Explain that both callers can observe the resource as unowned before either caller updates ownership.
Identify that createdAt - now reverses the cache-age subtraction and yields a negative age for stale entries.
State that cache age must be calculated as now - entry.createdAt.
Identify that required.some accepts one matching permission while the invariant requires every required scope.
Identify that Array.slice expects an absolute end index, so the page end must be offset + limit.
Identify and correct the epoch-seconds versus epoch-milliseconds mismatch in lease expiry comparison.
In suggestedRemediation, name issuedAtSeconds, maxAgeSeconds and nowMs and state their dimensionally valid normalization before the strict expiry comparison.
